notes: The diagram is schematic and has no scale: it is fitted with a similarity transform on five points where its Plaza Room front and the wings' north walls meet the mapped (roof) outline; the drawn Plaza Room is narrower than the roof's curved front, so the residuals are 3 to 5 m at the curve's ends.

Floor: UCLA Space Inventory lists De Neve Commons floors 1 to 3 (P1xx, P2xx, P3xx). The Learning Center P333 is on the 3rd floor (ResLife), the four PE entrance records are on floor 2 (the plaza / front-desk level), and this level has its side wings under the plaza, so it is taken as floor 1. The plan itself gives no floor; this is an inference.
Room names come from the plan (Plaza Room Salon A/B, Lecture Auditorium, Sycamore, Magnolia, Jacaranda, Computer Lab 1/2); the plan has no room numbers, so none are recorded.
The plan is cut off at the bottom (south), so the record covers the north part of the level only; two cuts close the foyer where it opens to the outdoor stairs.
